typography.headline_description: Editorial, elegant French luxury typography for primary titles and manifesto chapters

hierarchy_rules.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-[1.05]

design_archetype.fusion_note: A luxury botanical fusion: editorial French apothecary meets high-precision modern e-commerce.

key_features_and_components.navigation_header: Glassmorphic floating navbar with brand logo, 5 primary links, user auth avatar, loyalty points chip, favorites count (heart), cart drawer trigger, and theme toggle.
key_features_and_components.kinetic_hero: Awwwards-level split hero with masked line-by-line reveal, floating olive botanical imagery, live status badge 'Ouvert 7j/7 - 24h/24', and quick category jump triggers.
key_features_and_components.slow_editorial_marquee: Low contrast, slow-scrolling botanical ticker with organic separation icons highlighting key promises: 'Produits 100% Certifiés', 'Conseil Pharmacien 24/7', 'Livraison Express', 'Programme Privilège'.
key_features_and_components.numbered_manifesto: 3-chapter story layout ('01. Sourcing Naturel', '02. Rigueur Pharmacologique', '03. Engagement Local') with asymmetrical image-text grid.
key_features_and_components.product_catalog: Filterable grid (Soins Visage, Dermatologie, Hygiène & Corps, Compléments, Bébés) showing standard price & discounted Member Price (Prix Membre Privilège), tier badges, and quick favorite toggle.
key_features_and_components.loyalty_dashboard: Bronze / Silver / Gold tier progression bar, points calculator, unlocked gift catalog, and tier-exclusive discounts.
key_features_and_components.live_chat_widget: Bottom-right real-time client-admin chat interface with automated welcome message, quick FAQ buttons, and active status indicator.
key_features_and_components.admin_back_office: Full management suite: stock overview, order tracking, product bulk selection by category, revenue analytics charts, and real-time Theme Color Customizer (Olive, Terracotta, Sage, Midnight).
key_features_and_components.favorites_drawer: Quick sliding panel showing saved products with 1-click 'Tout ajouter au panier'.
key_features_and_components.footer: 5-column comprehensive footer (A propos, Catégories, Programme Fidélité, Contact & Direct, Légal) with direct links to Google Maps, Instagram, and phones.
